rows.conditions: Off-peak; peak doubles all three. Current 14:05/20:05 UTC jobs are off-peak.
Explicit cache storage costs extra; batch is asynchronous.
Older model/account availability must be checked.
Additional cache writes and different service tiers have separate rates. Closed model; comparison only under current open-model preference.

decision: Qualify existing-account DeepSeek Flash for bounded evidence tasks first. Retain Pro for substantive synthesis. Ling/GLM/Qwen are additional open-model candidates; they require independent quality, context, API compatibility and billing qualification. Gemini is not the cheapest current option; Kimi K2.5 output is materially dearer than Flash.
qualification_limits: Published rates do not prove equal quality, availability, context, tokenizer counts, caching behavior, latency or tool costs. No other provider was enabled or charged.
batching: Provider batch discounts suit independent extraction with flexible completion time. Multi-step acquisition depends on prior tool results and cannot be submitted as one flat batch. GPU batching needs measured throughput including model loading and idle time; no Lambda instance was rented for this production rollout.
